ModMetaData.name: Giddy-Up 2: Take Flight
ModMetaData.author: Phonicmas
ModMetaData.description:
An addon for Giddy-Up 2 that lets flying mounts actually fly. Flying over terrain: - Riders on a flying mount ignore terrain movement costs. Marsh, mud, sand and shallow water cost nothing extra. - They can cross deep water. Snow still slows them, and walls, buildings and closed doors still block them. Take flight: - A rider on a flying mount gets a "Take flight" button. Pick a spot within range and the mount carries its rider there through the air, over walls and water. - Afterwards the mount needs to rest for a while before it can take flight again. - By default both the take-off and landing spot need open sky. World flight: - Riders on flying mounts, or a caravan with them, can fly to another tile on the world map. The destination options are the same as transport pods: form a caravan, land on one of your maps, visit or attack a settlement, visit a site. - Every flying animal has a base range in tiles. Lighter loads fly further: at half the mount's carrying capacity the range doubles, up to ×3 by default. - A mount carrying more than its carrying capacity can't take flight at all. - After a world flight the mount rests for a while, longer the further it flew. - Riders who can't fly stay behind as their own caravan. Which animals fly: - Animals that can fly in vanilla (the flight system from Odyssey). - Floating creatures from Vanilla Expanded Framework, such as the Alpha Animals floaters and the Dark Ages phrak. - The dragons from Dragons Descent, the winged hybrids from Dragon Genetics and the harpeagle from Mythic Ages: Megafauna Bestiary. - Any mountable animal can be switched on or off in the mod settings, along with the flight ranges, speed, rest times and the open sky rule. For modders: Mark an animal as a flying mount with the GiddyUpTakeFlight.FlyingMount mod extension. Every field is optional; leave one out to use the mod setting. Example, directly on your animal's ThingDef: MyGriffin ...
